text.p: Shares in building material supplier RMC Group Plc defied the overall weaker market on Tuesday as market-makers were short of the stock, dealers said.
By 1200 GMT the stock was squeezed up 18p to 10.19-1/2 stg in volume of 600 thousand shares.
"The share price has been weak recently, so that it was time for a correction", one trader said. "But nobody seems to have the stock".
Apart from the stock shortage, some investors would see significant improvements in the group's German business, an analyst said.
"I think they have seen the worst there", the analyst said. Though the construction industry in Germany would pick up just slowly, RMC should be able to return better results, he said.
In May RMC said it had a reasonable start to the current financial year but warned that the strong pound could offset some of the underlying improvements.
